acceptance.command: VrStrobeControllerInputCoordinatorTest, controller snapshot tests, static routing checks, and attended Touch-controller readback
acceptance.proof: While a stimulus is selected, right A randomizes the exact unified selection revision most recently adopted by panel selection or either-stick cycling. One app-owned action arbiter accepts the first Android key/motion or Spatial SDK snapshot edge and suppresses duplicate platform observations within a bounded cross-route window; neither observation path owns a second randomize callback. Numbered ingress, press, randomize-start, renderer-submission, later-frame, randomize-complete, and press-complete markers expose the full transaction. No Pause/Resume panel action, callback, or safety state exists. B-close blocks descendant focus, clears/disables the backing root, hides the native PanelSceneObject, and hides the ECS entity, so a hidden surface cannot retain the conflicting hit target. Randomize preserves the output lifecycle. The next horizontal flick continues from that preset index. Stable local left and right controller components remain valid snapshot samples even when Meta transiently reports isActive=false. Left primary stores the exact current stimulus, distance, carrier mode, and concavity; right trigger is reserved for pointed panel interaction and owns no Store route. In flat mode either thumbstick vertical movement adjusts distance; in curved mode left Y adjusts concavity and right Y adjusts distance. Right B opens or closes the VR Strobe panel independently of output and every open recenters/faces it from the current viewer pose. Valid-sample release confirmation, cross-route deduplication, and dominant-axis arbitration prevent controller-source dropouts, duplicate observations, or diagonal input from repeating actions.

acceptance.command: VrStrobeRandomizationTest, VrStrobeStoredProfileAuthorityTest, source-pinned static gate, app restart readback, and attended panel load
acceptance.proof: Trevor's pinned sim.html and strobe.html controls remain outer compatibility bounds, while the Quest Randomize action uses the tested quest-reliable-v3 subset: separated bright palettes, bounded brightness/contrast, positive-width or disabled vignette, at most three active patterns with one active distortion and wave branch, and 1..30 Hz/20..80 percent temporal values. A mixed coarse/fine spatial distribution gives the fine bands 60 percent selection weight and reaches global scale 16, stripe/ripple and ray period 50, and Perlin scale 40 without adding fragment evaluations or relaxing the viability guards. The shader rejects equal-edge vignette input from older profiles. Candidate markers expose envelope acceptance, fine-detail presence, spatial ranges, costly branch counts, and host transaction duration. Each active randomize stages its at-most-26 profile attributes on the single live material through cached numeric indices, writes no more than six attributes per scene tick, repeats the bounded profile pass once, commits active pattern counts last in each pass, and advances the continuously reasserted visible generation only after the profile publication completes. Rapid accepted actions queue rather than overwrite one another; inactive slots remain untouched, and a later scene-frame receipt remains distinct from attended visible adoption. Panel and left-primary storage share one versioned app-private authority that round-trips exact interference/temporal parameters, spatial distance, carrier mode, and concavity across restart. A versioned human-readable JSON bundle is the single Quest/browser interchange contract; Quest import replaces the stored list transactionally, Quest export mirrors the effective list, and the flat browser editor validates the same bounds and profile vocabulary. The browser warning is a dedicated session-scoped entry gate; one command authority owns Left/Right cycling, Space pause/resume, Up randomize, Down per-profile bounded LIFO restore, and S session-only snapshot storage. Session snapshots join browser cycling and explicit download but never silently enter persistent browser storage. Version 3 binary storage remains readable internally for migration, while browser interchange never depends on Android SharedPreferences bytes.

acceptance.command: Shader compilation, VrStrobeGpuPlanTest, static shader budget checks, and attended headset GPU-frame evidence
acceptance.proof: The full-field carrier is one bounded 32-ring by 96-segment radial disc rather than a double-sided box. Its 2.84 m radius and 4.00 m default distance begin at the controller range maximum, allowing the selected carrier to remain active behind the 0.82 m panel. It defaults to curved mode at maximum concavity, the full 180-degree viewer-facing hemisphere; flat mode remains available, and joystick changes update one uniform without geometry rebuilds or added fragment evaluations. The viewer-facing +Z winding is rendered front-sided only so folded back faces cannot add redundant fragment work. Randomize updates the single material already bound to the visible carrier through a bounded cached-index multi-frame commit, increments an explicit staged renderer revision, advances the visible revision only after two complete profile passes, and performs no SceneObject mesh swap, retaining one visible draw and continuous time-uniform ownership. The commit adds no fragment work and stays below the former full-clear mutation count. Quest randomization permits at most one optional distortion branch and one wave branch. Inactive pattern slots are packed out and uniform counts terminate shader loops, and the combined interference/trail/blur/glow path uses exactly one complete interference-signal evaluation per fragment rather than three or seven. Derivative band limiting and decorrelated post noise reject the observed large square-line raster artifact.

acceptance.command: VrStrobeDepthDeformationTest, VrStrobeCarrierGeometryTest, shader compilation, focused static gate, bounded launch smoke, and attended headset comparison
acceptance.proof: Depth deformation is an app-owned experimental option that defaults on at the full symmetric 1.42 m maximum, exactly half the 2.84 m carrier radius; it is available only for selected interference stimuli and never deforms temporal output. The panel separates current/effective state from a button whose label describes the next action, and a quadratic slider preserves centimeter-scale control near zero. The depth coordinate follows the stimulus palette roles rather than RGB luminance: for two colors slot 1 is far and slot 2 near; for three colors slot 1 is far, slot 2 remains on the carrier, and slot 3 is near. The same band-limited interference signal therefore integrates geometry with the visible pattern even when palette colors have similar brightness. At displacement above 5 cm only the geometric bandwidth adapts smoothly from 12 to 4 while the fragment image retains its full fine detail, limiting severe folds and self-overdraw. The front-sided 32-by-96 carrier displaces along an analytic viewer-facing flat or spherical normal. The original fragment hot path retains one interference-signal evaluation, no gl_FragDepth is written, one material and one draw remain, and host/runtime markers separate requested, effective, and temporal-suppressed state.
